confidences.reason: At Step 1, the plan explicitly tasked WebSurfer with identifying the racetrack by watching the YouTube video at the two-minute mark. Later in the log (Step 19), WebSurfer states it cannot watch YouTube videos directly. This shows the initial plan depended on a capability the tool lacks, making the plan infeasible from the start.

Step 1 laid out a reasonable plan: identify the track (via WebSurfer) and then look up the record. It did not explicitly require watching the video; the track could have been identified through descriptions, comments, or episode guides. The first explicit commitment to an impossible action ("watch the video at the two-minute mark") appears later (e.g., Steps 6/8), and the tool limitation was only revealed at Step 19. Therefore, Step 1 is not the earliest mistake committing the process to an impossible action.

The log shows repeated attempts to have WebSurfer watch the video (which it couldn't) and only later tries alternative sources (wiki, Reddit, forums). At no point was the racetrack successfully identified, nor was the world record time provided. The process never recovered to resolve the core blockage.
Step 1 exists in the log and its agent is 'Orchestrator'.
